seo.title: How It Works — Free Preview Website to Launch | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: From application to a private 7-day preview to activation and launch — see exactly how SynergyFirst Digital's Free Preview Website and managed subscription work.
seo.ogDescription: From application to a private 7-day preview to activation and launch.

h1: From application to a live website you actually approved

sections.subheading: Here's exactly what happens between applying for a free preview and having your website live and managed.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: You tell us about your business. We review every application to confirm we can create something genuinely useful.

steps.title: We build your preview website
steps.body: If you qualify, we create a private concept website from a clean niche starter — no cost, no obligation.

steps.title: Seven-day review
steps.body: You get a private link with a live countdown to a fixed expiry. It's not public and isn't accepting customer enquiries yet.

steps.title: Activate
steps.body: Like what you see? Choose a monthly plan to move forward. Terms, ownership and pricing are confirmed before you commit.

steps.title: We complete it
steps.body: We finish the approved pages and content based on your feedback.

steps.title: Connect your domain
steps.body: We connect your own domain — you always retain ownership of it.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Production metadata, analytics, forms and indexing are switched on and your site goes live.

steps.title: Ongoing management
steps.body: Hosting, maintenance and your plan's monthly update allowance continue for as long as you're subscribed.

sections.heading: What the process feels like, in clients’ words
What your preview does (and doesn't) include

items.title: A real, working concept site
items.body: Built on our niche starter so you can see real pages, not a static mockup.

items.title: Private and unpublished
items.body: Not indexed, not linked publicly, and not currently taking customer enquiries.

items.title: A fixed 7-day window
items.body: A live countdown to a set expiry — it never resets on refresh or a new device.

items.title: Completion happens after activation
items.body: Your own content, final approved pages and domain connection are finished once you activate a plan.

items.title: Basic business details
items.body: The information collected in the free preview application.

items.title: Sign-off on your preview
items.body: Feedback on what to keep, change or finish once you activate.

items.title: Access to your domain
items.body: So we can connect it once your plan is active.
